content:
maria: Heads-up — console showed a customer with a small streaming request get a negative provisional token delta after a router-region shuffle.
kevin: negative provisional delta? can you paste the logs / screenshot?
maria: screenshot attached in thread (pv: -12 tokens). logs: 
```
2026-03-12T15:19:02Z router: session=svc-42 route=us-west-1 -> us-east-1 reason=capacity_burst
2026-03-12T15:19:02Z runtime: session=svc-42 prefix_len=18 tokens_emitted=34 status=streaming
2026-03-12T15:19:03Z runtime: session=svc-42 toolcall=ocr_v1 truncated=true tokens_tool=6
2026-03-12T15:19:05Z router: session=svc-42 ack=resume confirmed=true
2026-03-12T15:19:05Z billing: session=svc-42 provisional_credit=-12
```
I think we double-count a truncated toolcall as both provisional and then subtract it during reconcile, but the route tag got swapped so the token ownership landed on a different ledger shard.
sam: ah — we already have heuristics for retry dedupe (session id + seq). Is this just missing route provenance when we do handoff?
kevin: probable. router currently sets X-Route-Tag on initial path but we overwrite it on handoff. the ledger key is route_tag + session_prefix. if those differ we write to two shards.
irene: does the runtime attach a canonical provenance id anywhere? We added request-trace-id in 2025 but it's not used for billing keys.
ben: correct. billing keys are still route-tagged. consequence: provisional ledger increments on origin shard, then final reconcile subtracts on new shard so console shows negative on origin and refund on new one — but UX only surfaces origin which confuses ops.
maria: customers see a weird -12 line and auto-refund bulk rule kicks in. they open a ticket. not great.
kevin: short-term mitigation idea: when we handoff, copy the original route_tag into X-Orig-Route and include it in the final billing entry as provenance metadata. then ledger writes should attempt to merge by provenance id before applying reconcile adjustments.
sam: merging in ledger requires idempotency keys. we can use session_id + client_prefix + orig_route as the idempotency key. easy to add. any risk?
irene: watch out for churn: if we keep orig_route forever, the routing metrics per-route become inaccurate. console dashboards rely on route_tag to split cost by region. we need both: preserve provenance for billing dedupe, but still attribute confirmed final cost to the final route for analytics.
kevin: agree. propose: 1) provenance-only field used for provisional dedupe/merge, 2) final confirmed cost emitted with final_route tag for analytics. Reconcile job then consumes provenance to do ledger arithmetic but pushes confirmed cost to the final shard.
ben: ops-bot: created incident #INC-2026-042, assigned to eng-platform. :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: deploy suggestion: small router change + ledger idempotency patch. staging canary at 10%.
maria: UI side: console should show "provisional (pending reconcile)" breakdown and avoid surfacing negative deltas as absolute — show them as "pending adjustment" with link to reconcile trace. that prevents support escalations.
irene: agreed. add a reconcile trace link that joins routing events (hand-off), toolcall truncation event, and billing ops. That will help SRE debug.
kevin: implementation plan:
- router: add X-Orig-Route header during handoff (1 day)
- runtime: propagate request-trace-id to billing events (half day)
- ledger: add idempotency key = "session|prefix|orig_route" and merge on provisional create (2 days)
- reconcile: emit confirmed_cost with final_route tag and create reconcile audit record (2 days)
- console: UI copy + minor UX change to label provisional rows and link to trace (1 day)
Total: ~6 working days, can stage pieces independently.
sam: Can we short-circuit with a temporary console filter? hide provisional rows < 0 until reconcile completes?
ben: that would silence symptoms but not fix double accounting. fine as emergency bandaid for next 24-48h.
maria: I'll file the console PR for the UI copy and temporary filter. cc @kevin for router change.
kevin: I'll open the router PR and include tests for header preservation during handoff. also add small sim harness to reproduce negative provisional.
irene: add an alert: reconcile-run-failure should escalate if provisional negative > X tokens across shard in 5m.
ops-bot: canary started for router change (10%) — logs show X-Orig-Route header preserved in 95% of handoffs so far.
kevin: nice. need one more unit test edgecase: toolcall truncated mid-handshake where tokens_tool appears after handoff log.
sam: I can add that test. it's the weirdest case: runtime emits toolcall truncated on old shard and runtime on new shard writes final ack — need to ensure idempotency keys unify.
ben: tl;dr: root cause = route_tag mutation during handoff + ledger writes keyed by route_tag; short fix = propagate orig route provenance + ledger idempotency; UX fix = surface provisional vs confirmed and hide negative surprises.
maria: thanks folks. I'll add the support template for tickets in case customers hit this while we roll. :pray:
kevin: tracking PRs: router: r/3456, ledger: r/3459, console: r/3460, tests: r/3461.
ben: closing interim incident when canary hits 100% and reconcile job shows <1 negative-event/min.
ops-bot: incident #INC-2026-042 marked monitoring.
